svg.aria-label: A terminal running six PhDude commands in turn - status, next, research list, manuscript status, health and ready - each printing its real output.
svg.title: A terminal running six PhDude commands in turn - status, next, research list, manuscript status, health and ready - each printing its real output.
svg.desc: An animated terminal recording. Six commands are typed one after another against the example thesis workspace that ships with PhDude. phdude status prints 19 lines; phdude next prints 19 lines; phdude research list --state candidate prints 4 lines; phdude manuscript status prints 9 lines; phdude health prints 19 lines; phdude ready prints 19 lines. The same output is in docs/guide.md as text.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', monospace
